title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
manual_steps: Story Mode only, with BattlEye disabled using the game launcher option (-nobattleye).
Restore FreeFG before playing GTA Online: without -nobattleye, OptiScaler stays inactive (RequireArgument), but its DLL still loads beside BattlEye.
Select DLSS in the game (Quality was tested); leave the game's frame generation off. FreeFG enables XeFG through OptiFG.
Use the bundled OptiScaler ba0dedb or a descendant (Social Club factory fix, RequireArgument); leave DxgiFactoryWrapping at auto/false and remove any SocialClubD3D12Renderer DLL-disable override.
note: GTA 1.0.1158.16, GE-Proton11-11, AMD FSR 4 RC12. The anti-cheat installation refusal still requires explicit per-game acceptance. The Social Club overlay stays available.
observed: Story Mode bank prologue, movement and Social Club open/close; sustained 2.0 generated presents per game frame, including a fresh start with XeFG enabled and starts with RequireArgument unset and set to -nobattleye

qualification.limits: Short Story Mode starts: two with OptiScaler 273e8d4 (October 30), two with ba0dedb (October 31: RequireArgument unset, and set to -nobattleye). Only GTA5_Enhanced.exe loads OptiScaler on the Steam route, with -nobattleye on its command line. A start without -nobattleye (BattlEye), Online, long play, 3x/4x, HDR and pacing were not tested.
